name: GENCODE and MANE transcript sets
scope: Comprehensive human gene annotation (GENCODE) and the matched Ensembl/RefSeq clinical transcript set (MANE Select / Plus Clinical).
mapping_methods: Matched Ensembl and RefSeq transcripts at identical genomic positions.

licence.name: GENCODE: 'all the GENCODE project data is open access' (GENCODE data-access page), under the EMBL-EBI Terms of Use (freely available, no additional restriction, attribution expected). MANE files are hosted by NCBI: NCBI places no restrictions on use or distribution, though original submitters may claim rights, and acknowledgement of NLM is requested.
licence.redistribution: Open with attribution (cite GENCODE and MANE); NCBI notes that third-party rights may exist in submitted data. Only the MANE files are acquired here.

coverage_limitations: MANE covers one transcript per protein-coding gene

reuse_decision.rationale: MANE files are small and fix the transcript choice needed to interpret HGVS across ClinVar, MaveDB and gnomAD; the GENCODE genome FASTA (806 to 856 MB) is deferred.
